buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses [A] Bidder must submit following documents along with their offer. 1. Bid must be submitted by OEM or their authorised dealers only. In case where bid is submitted by autho rised dealer, bidder must attach bid specific authorisation from OEM. Failing which offer shall be summaril y rejected, without any back reference. 2. Bidder must upload a duly signed copy of duly filled ANNEXTURE "A", 'B' , 'C' as attached in the ATC. 3. Bidder must attach past performance certificates along with their offer. 4. Documents in support of Make in India policy i.e. % of local content in the offered product for purchase p reference. 5. Documents in support of MSE registration. (for MSE purchase preference). 6. Relevant documents confirming to IS 13018, IS: 10002/1981, IS: 10000/ISO-3046/BS: 649/BS 5514 latest version as mentioned under point no. 11 in ANNEXURE "A" as attached in the ATC. 7. Relevant document confirming to IS 13364 (Part-II latest version) for Alternator version as mentioned un der point no 22 in ANNEXURE "A" as attached in the ATC 8. Relevant document confirming to ISO 8528 (Voltage regulation grade) as mentioned under point no 23 i n ANNEXURE "A" as attached in the ATC 9. Relevant test reports as mentioned under point No. 43 in ANNEXURE "A" as attached in the ATC. 10. Relevant valid Type Approval Certificate for the specified rating of the Power Generator from any of the designated agency authorized by CPCB, COP Certificate for engine, Type test report and Endurance test re port for Engine as per IS: 10001 latest / IS: 10002 latest, Type test report for Alternator as per IS:13364 (P art-1) latest / IS:13364 (Part-2) latest to prove conformity to the specifications. 11. Relevant documents confirming to GTR as mentioned under point No. 44 in the ANNEXURE "A" as attac hed in the ATC. 12.The OEM warranty certificate shall be duly signed by the authorized signatory and shall clearly mention the name, designation, mobile number, and e-mail ID of the authorized signatory. The bid/tender number shall also be clearly mentioned, and the certificate shall be issued on the OEM's letterhead. 13. DG set must be conforming to CPCB-IV+ (Noise and emission) norms. The firm shall provide the releva nt documents along with the offer 14. DG set must be conforming to CPWD specification of DG sets available in CPWD's document "General s pecifications for Electrical works Part-VII-2013". Bidder must submit clause wise compliance for CPWD spe cifications along with offer 15.The tendering firm must have valid Electrical Contractors License issued by any State Government in t heir own name or in the name of the firm/OEM at the time of opening of tender. A copy of the license shall be uploaded along with the tender offer failing which the offer shall be summarily rejected. [B] Material should be supply, Installation, Commissioning include Complete Foundation, 4 Nos. Earthing as pe r IS, Transportation with in Firozpur Division. (Tentative Location at BEAS & FZR) or Decided by competent authority ie SR. DEE/G/ FZR before Supply. [C] 1. Bidder must mention the place of inspection for RITES Inspection. 2. Scope of work: Supply, Installation, Testing & Commissioning (Incl. Earthing & foundation work) of DG se t as per CPWD specification available in CPWD's website "General specifications for Electrical Work Part-VII -2013" . 2. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC
